text_block_list.name: Father's Coach
text_block_list.text:
……It's fine. It's not a problem.
You worked harder 
than anyone else,
so there's no need to be nervous——

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
——I understand, coach. However,
I can feel it clearly. 
I'm less experienced than anyone.
I don't know anything……!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Father……this video you just showed me……

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
……Dura. 
That you truly look up to and respect us,
I understand that.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
And that, like us,
you're aiming to become the "Strongest". But,
you see——

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
The ones you look up to. Us,
and the Uma Musume too. 
In the beginning,
none of them were called the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes they were unprepared,
or had their weaknesses exposed.
Sometimes they were overcome 
by nervousness……but they gradually grew
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
……You don't have to be perfect from the start.
Rather, 
if there are things you are lacking,
find out what they are.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
That would help out your instructors.
……Isn't that right,
Trainer-san? Once you've found what 
you're weak at,
you can strategize around it.
choice_data_list: Yes, that's how you can get stronger

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
……See? It's fine. 
That's why it's okay, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
……Oh, look at the time. 
Hey, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose this person as your Dance
escort?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose this person as your Dance
escort?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……! W-well, that's——

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
……you forgot until the last minute,
and they 
were the one that offered to help,
am I right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: How did you——!?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaa. It's you, after all. You were so 
preoccupied thinking you had to dance
perfectly 
for the party that you only focused on
practice, right?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't stop thinking about that either.
……And about how I could 
tell you this. As your father,
about how I should advise you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Father.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Even the way you sought help was the
same. 
Like father, like daughter, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……I'll be fine from here. 
That you were there today really helped.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes…………

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Trainer. 
Father was praising you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (……I should be the one thanking them.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Father said it. 
……Someone like you is indispensable)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……I was planning on entering the next
Selection Race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was necessary to win 
first place before debuting. But, now——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……even if you were to change your mind, 
I would still want you to be my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I want to ask for your help again.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To the "Imperfect Me", you reached out. 
I want to run together with you in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Wearing Red ...
text_block_list.text:
W-why is Duramente with that rookie!?
In the last Selection 
Race,
it didn't seem like she was interested in
being scouted!

text_block_list.name: Stylish Trainer
text_block_list.text:
We'll find out the reason during this mock
race, won't we? 
And how things will go after this……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Suuu-……Fuuu-……

text_block_list.name: Previous Generation ...
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd be taking a deep breath.
Are you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Yes. A little.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
But, I won't try to hide it anymore. 
I know now that showing it openly will help
me get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Gate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To all the participating Uma Musume,
please enter your gates! 
Are you all ready? Well then——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(……In this race,
many people will be gauging me. 
The strength of Duramente.
The strength of someone 
who has inherited the blood of the
"Strongest")

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sweating. My face is a mess.
My heart is pounding. 
Everyone must be seeing the imperfect me. But,
even then——)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
…………In the next moments……I will become
stronger……!

Duramente accelerated. Faster,
and faster. 
With a speed that nobody could catch——

——This is where Duramente becoming the
"Strongest" would begin.
